proposals.title: Requests a Corporate Financial Sustainability Board Committee
proposals.proponent: The National Center for Public Policy Research
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a board committee on corporate financial sustainability to oversee and review the impact of the company's policy positions, advocacy, partnerships and charitable giving on social and political matters, with a public report by end of 2024.
proposals.evidence: The Board believes that establishing a separate corporate sustainability committee is not necessary to achieve effective Board oversight of these matters.

proposals.title: Requests a Risk Report of Opposing State Abortion Regulation
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a public report on known and foreseeable risks and costs to the company from opposing or altering company policy in response to state abortion regulations, and mitigation strategies.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that you vote " AGAINST " this proposal.

proposals.title: Requests an Excessive Golden Parachute Approval Policy
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy requiring shareholder approval of senior executive pay packages with golden parachute payments exceeding 2.99 times base salary plus target bonus.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that you vote " AGAINST " this proposal.
